messages:
maya: FYI hitting a parity bug in sampleapp rerank flow on node. Embedding response shape is nested when batchSize=1 and reranker chokes (expects flat float array).

owen: Repro:
```js
const res = await client.embeddings.create({ model: 'embed-small-001', input: ['hello'] })
// res.data -> [ [ [0.01, 0.02, ...] ] ]  <-- triple-nested
```
This breaks downstream code that does `vec.length === 1536`.

nico: I dug in: node SDK's batch helper intentionally keeps the per-request container shape (so multi-request results align), but we forgot to normalize single-item batches. Python SDK flattens singletons, so parity mismatch.

maya: Also noticed a weird auth+retry interaction: when token refresh triggers mid-batch our retry wrapper replays the whole batch without dedupe header, causing duplicate logical requests and occasionally the server folding arrays differently.

owen: Quick hack in sampleapp to make CI green:
```js
function normalizeEmbeddings(data){
  // collapse one-level wrappers until elements are numbers
  while(Array.isArray(data) && data.length === 1 && Array.isArray(data[0]) ) data = data[0]
  return data
}
```
Not ideal but reduces flakes.

nico: I'll open two PRs: (1) sdk: flatten-singletons normalization + unit tests, (2) retry: attach X-Request-Id per logical batch and make retry wrapper idempotent.

maya: Could we also add a small e2e that runs rerank pipeline with batch size 1/2/3 and checks shapes? Add to `ci/integration/devex.yml` so this doesn't regress.

ops-bot: scheduled job `canary-sdk-hotfix` queued — build 9872 — 1805851480

owen: I'll update sampleapp README with an example of the exact shape consumers should expect per SDK (node vs python note) + migration note for v0.3.1 -> v0.3.2.

nico: Link to PRs when ready. I'll add tests that simulate token refresh by returning 401 mid-batch and ensure dedupe prevents double-processing.

maya: Thanks. Let's try to get the flattening PR out today, then follow up on the idempotent retry change. :thumbsup:
